title: AI Gateway Anthropic usage parsing: reuse the module-level Anthropic usage helpers for any passthrough that returns Anthropic bodies unchanged
answers: Why do gateway traces show blank input and output tokens and no cost for Claude on Bedrock?
How is Anthropic token usage parsed for streaming chunks in the gateway, and where is that code?
Where should a new provider get usage extraction if it proxies Anthropic Messages responses?
Why does Anthropic input_tokens get normalized to include cache tokens in the gateway?
body:
Path: Token usage extraction for the Anthropic Messages passthrough, both the unary response body and streaming SSE chunks, lives in mlflow/gateway/providers/anthropic.py. It is used by AnthropicProvider and by AmazonBedrockProvider for Claude models, and the result feeds the span's token counts and cost on gateway traces.
Rule: Use the module-level helpers _extract_anthropic_passthrough_token_usage and _extract_anthropic_streaming_token_usage as the one parser for Anthropic usage. They normalize input_tokens to include cache tokens. A provider whose passthrough returns Anthropic bodies or events unchanged should delegate its _extract_passthrough_token_usage and _extract_streaming_token_usage overrides to these helpers instead of reimplementing the parsing.
Symptom: If a passthrough skips usage extraction, the span gets no usage, so the trace shows blank tokens and cost for the call.
Constraints: Applies only when the upstream response shape is Anthropic's. Bedrock InvokeModel qualifies, since it returns Anthropic response bodies and stream events unchanged. Do not use these helpers for OpenAI-shaped or Gemini responses.
applies: Usage and cost extraction for Anthropic-format responses in AI Gateway providers, including Bedrock Claude passthrough; not for other provider response formats.
says: Gateway traces show blank input and output tokens and no cost for Claude on Bedrock
Token usage and cost missing from AI Gateway traces for Anthropic models served through Bedrock
Streaming Claude responses through the gateway show no token counts on the trace span
search: AI Gateway Anthropic usage parsing: reuse the shared module-level Anthropic usage helpers for unary and streaming passthrough responses that return Anthropic bodies unchanged, so span token counts and cost are filled. Those helpers normalize input_tokens to include cache tokens; do not use them for OpenAI-shaped or Gemini responses.
